# ProyTech Business Solutions LLC

> ProyTech builds the Growth OS for small businesses: a custom website and a Business Suite (CRM + back office) that work together, so every lead from the site lands in one dashboard that shows the whole business on one screen. Two founders, based in Wichita, Kansas, building for businesses across the country. Most builds go live in 14 days.

## What we do
- Custom websites that build brand and send every lead into the Business Suite.
- Business Suite: a CRM and back office that tracks every lead, client, dollar, and teammate in one place.
- Automations: missed-call text back, Google review requests, instant lead replies, appointment reminders, new-lead follow up.
- The Growth OS: the website and Business Suite built together around how a specific business runs.

## Who we build for
Realtors and lenders, home-services businesses (roofing, HVAC, plumbing, electrical, auto and diesel repair), and local service businesses that want to grow without hiring.

## How to start
Every engagement starts with a free 2-hour Growth Plan: we map goals, numbers, and the levers that move them, and you leave with a written plan whether you work with us or not. Book at https://getproytech.com/book
